weeks.shortDescription:
Each journey is intuitively and intentionally guided, blending grounded basslines with celestial vocals, ancestral remembrance, and spacious integration.

Whether through earth- and bass-driven DJ sets, live-looped soul transmissions, heart-opening singer-songwriter acoustic music, or crystalline sound baths, CYRENITY creates immersive dance temples where sound and movement become ceremony and medicine.

Find all of her music online under CYRENITY. 💛🏔️✨💗
weeks.bio:
CYRENITY is a multidimensional music artist, DJ, and ceremonial sound healer crafting immersive dance journeys that bridge devotion, bass, synths, and deep inner awakening.

She curates conscious dance floors that move through play, beauty, connection, and sensuality, weaving yummy EDM, dirty bass, expansive house, ethereal world textures, melodic techno, and spiritual tribal music with her etheric vocals and original productions—cultivating deeper connection through sound, movement & spirit.
weeks.name: Dj Cyrenity
weeks.somaticBlurb:
Tai Chi Dance with Owl 
~
To move from center is to move as one…

This workshop explores the realms of energy movement, balance, intentional coordination, and the fluidity of water. Integrating tai chi into dance is not about moving or appearing any particular way. Instead, it’s an invitation to restore and deepen our connection with the Earth, and walk more fully in the glory of our authentic selves. P
